name: Journey to Astranaar
summary: From Theramore, Fiora Longears sends Alliance travelers north to Astranaar. There, they report to Shindrell Swiftfire as war and unrest trouble Ashenvale.

sections.title: From the Coast into the Woods
sections.body: Alliance travelers reach Dustwallow Marsh by ferry from Menethil Harbor, often seeking purpose in northern Kalimdor. At Theramore, Fiora Longears sends capable hands inland to Astranaar, Ashenvale's main night elven settlement. The road passes beneath ancient, shadowed canopies and enters a forest strained by war and unrest.

sections.title: An Unspoken Recommendation
sections.body: Fiora asks travelers not to mention her name in Astranaar, because Shindrell Swiftfire does not know her. Fiora directs fresh Alliance talent to places where help is needed, and Shindrell welcomes able-bodied defenders when they arrive. Ashenvale remains breathtaking, though it is no longer the peaceful sanctuary it once was.

faq.q: Where does the Journey to Astranaar quest begin?
aliases: where to pick up journey to astranaar
faq.answer: Fiora Longears sends Alliance travelers from Theramore, on the coast of Dustwallow Marsh. She welcomes those arriving from the Eastern Kingdoms who seek to help in Kalimdor.

faq.q: Who do I need to talk to in Astranaar?
aliases: where to turn in journey to astranaar
faq.answer: Speak with Shindrell Swiftfire, a night elf in Astranaar, Ashenvale's central Alliance town.

faq.q: Why does Fiora say not to mention her name?
faq.answer: Fiora asks you not to mention her because Shindrell does not know her personally. She directs eager newcomers to an outpost that needs help.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: The journey takes Alliance travelers from Dustwallow Marsh into Ashenvale and brings them to Astranaar, their main base in the forest.

faq.q: What kind of trouble is happening in Ashenvale?
faq.answer: Ashenvale is no longer tranquil. Horde incursions, demonic corruption left by the Third War, and local wildlife stirred by recent conflicts trouble the forest.

faq.q: What quest leads into Journey to Astranaar?
faq.answer: A short introduction called Fiora Longears sends travelers arriving in Dustwallow Marsh to speak with her in Theramore.

angles.text: As an Alliance recruit, you travel from the relatively safe ports of Dustwallow Marsh into Ashenvale's contested wilderness.
As a night elf, you return to your heartland under siege and defend Ashenvale's sacred boughs alongside foreign allies.
As a human arriving from Menethil Harbor, you take your first steps into Kalimdor's interior and honor the Alliance pledge to aid the night elves.
